prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1101; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision described in your insured's file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is now receiving medical care that is expected to continue for some time. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide the full liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, telematics or event data recorded by either vehicle, recorded statements, claim notes, and any surveillance or investigative materials. Routine deletion or disposal of these materials should be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm your company's response timeline within fourteen days.
